name: O Loan blood cockle
summary: The lagoon cockle. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note says the meat is pink with yellow roe, and that Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam put it in a Top 10 of Vietnamese seafood. Grill it on charcoal until the liquor runs. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Đầm Ô Loan, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s cockle note of 29 December 2020, its lagoon article, and its 6 October 2024 cẩm nang.
texture: The 29 December 2020 note says the meat is pink with yellow roe. The food roundup says the meat is thick.
taste: The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang says sò huyết rang muối ớt is lightly hot, fragrant, and sweet. The grilled plate is salt, pepper, and lime, eaten hot.
howToEat: Scrub the shell, soak out the mud, and grill on charcoal until the liquor runs. Open it with your hand, add a little salt, pepper, and lime, and eat it hot with a spoon. That is the 29 December 2020 note. The same note also puts the plate on a night boat in the lagoon.
The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang also names nướng tái, xào me, hấp, gỏi, and rang muối ớt. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Ô Loan, and the floating kitchens at cầu An Hải. Du lịch Phú Yên’s festival article puts the lagoon 25 km north of the city. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: O Loan cockles — grilled until the liquor runs
seoDescription: Pink cockles with yellow roe from Dam O Loan, grilled on charcoal with salt, pepper, and lime. The lagoon is 25 km north. A price is Check on arrival.
